verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Computer can create PDFs, slide decks, spreadsheets, images, and videos, and that it works in a sandboxed VM with a persistent file workspace. Iterative editing is supported by continuing the same session through a reused thread_id, which preserves context across follow-up requests. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of exporting or downloading created files, explicit description of in-place iterative editing of documents or presentations, and independent hands-on corroboration of file-creation quality.
